instruction: Look up the fees for vehicle title transfers in Virginia

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate from Virginia DMV homepage to the vehicle title transfer page. Evaluator checks if the final URL matches the expected pattern for title or title-transfer pages. Uses existing getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) and metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts active tab URL from accessibility tree
Metric correctly uses regex pattern matching to verify URL
Regex pattern accurately targets Virginia DMV title/title-transfer pages with proper domain and path matching
Data flow is correct: getter returns string URL, metric accepts both string and dict formats
URL verification is semantically appropriate for a navigation task starting from Virginia DMV homepage
Evaluator can verify that user navigated to the correct page for looking up title transfer fees
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The instruction says 'look up the fees' but evaluator only checks navigation to the correct page, not whether fee information was actually read. However, this is acceptable for a navigation-based task where reaching the title-transfer page is a reasonable proxy for task completion.
Optional: Could add postconfig to ensure Chrome remains active, but current getter handles this by reading from accessibility tree which should work as long as Chrome is open.
